intro: Seven stages, in order. Story first, then side strands, then activities, collectibles, robberies, money, and a final cleanup to 100% completion. The only trophy flagged missable by any guide so far is Positive Mental Attitude — do its first meditation in Chapter 1. Everything else is retryable or cumulative, as far as the official descriptions show.
missableNote: PowerPyx flags Positive Mental Attitude as the only potentially missable trophy (its first meditation, with Lucia in Chapter 1, can be missed). No other missable trophy is confirmed. Treat any other 'missable' claim as unverified until a guide confirms it.

stages.advice: Follow the main missions in order. Along the way, take the first meditation when it is offered in Chapter 1 (Positive Mental Attitude), try every activity you pass (Master of None), and grab collectible cards and WAiNK It spots as you travel. Do not rush past side icons — they feed Stage 2.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 4 and the finale

stages.advice: Work through the mission chains for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus Bret's hunting strand, and complete 8 stranger strands across Leonida. These unlock as the story progresses, so check the map for new stranger icons after each chapter.
stages.title: Finish the side-character strands

stages.advice: Try each of the 9 activity types once, finish an arcade game and bowl at Kolt & Associates, beat Cal at fishing, then grind the counts: 14 drone-race wins, 20 different race wins, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 250 stunts and 50 challenges. Races and stunts overlap, so do them together.
stages.title: Activities — sample everything, then master it

stages.advice: Meditate at all 18 spots, complete 3 card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, explore all 52 areas, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Do this as one long road trip across Leonida — most of these counters rise together.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration

stages.advice: Rob 5 bank vaults and an armored truck, hit one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs, rob a jewelry store undetected, rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner, take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, make the unscheduled departure at VCIA, and knock someone over with a melee drive-by. Plan each job with a getaway ready.
stages.title: Robberies, gangs and combat

stages.advice: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts and spend $100,000 across shops — both are cumulative and will be nearly done by now. The three vague trophies (Personal Best, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There) have no verified trigger yet: keep making choices, retry failed attempts, and watch for strange events; check this guide's updates as the community confirms them.
stages.title: Money and the odd ones out

stages.advice: Open the in-game 100% checklist and clear whatever it still lists: story missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries. When A Long Road (100%) pops, the platinum — Vice Got a Price! — follows immediately. Early estimates put the full run at roughly 200 to 300+ hours.
